title: Account Strategist, Mid-Market Sales, Google Customer Solutions (Ukrainian Market)
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Ireland: €76000 - €77500 (EUR) + 35% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver against ambitious quarterly business and product growth goals.
  • Own a portfolio of medium and large size businesses by thoroughly understanding growth drivers, identifying opportunities for growth, managing risks and building multi-quarter plans for achievement.
  • Pitch and consult with customers proactively to support annual digital marketing discussions and budgets.
  • Drive customer growth by delivering outstanding customer sales experience and achieving customer business and marketing objectives.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in digital advertising, consultative sales, digital media sales, business development, online media environment, or digital marketing role.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Ukrainian fluently to engage with clients in the region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience strategically assessing and achieving client success via sales techniques, including effective questioning, objection handling and competitive selling.
  • Knowledge of online marketing strategy and tactics, and expertise in managing digital advertising campaigns with a focus on performance marketing.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a portfolio in an advertising or media sales context in Ukraine, and consistently overachieve quotas to drive growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to build compelling narratives and utilize storytelling as a client engagement strategy.

descriptionHtml:

We are the driving team behind high-quality data – the essential ingredient for unlocking unprecedented AI breakthroughs. Partner with resourceful minds, define data excellence, and make an impact on the future of intelligent systems.

As a Senior Staff Research Data Scientist, you will be a key driver of innovation. This role demands deep expertise in machine learning and a strong foundation in core data science methodologies. You will be instrumental in conceiving and deploying solutions, directly contributing to the advancements of AI.

title: Operations Manager, Global Server Ops
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also address the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

You manage a team that ensures the quality installation of server hardware and components. You coordinate over multiple sites and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.

As a Server Operations Manager in the Third-Party Data Centers (TPDC) team, you'll be responsible for daily operations in third-party operated data center facilities. In this role, you'll manage a team of Data Center Operation Managers or Technicians and oversee the installation and maintenance of server and network infrastructure. You'll take charge of installations/troubleshooting and ensure timely completion of project work. As a people manager, you'll look after your team's development and career growth.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Netherlands: €144000 - €147000 (EUR) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the Data Center operations.
  • Lead a team of Operations Managers or Data Center Technician direct reports.  
  • Set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Maintain, monitor, and execute security and operational procedures and track/analyze trends to identify opportunities for improvements ensuring alignment with organizational policies.
  • Support and contribute to the implementation of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) and other compliance programs and initiatives in collaboration with other teams to ensure environmental and safety incidents are investigated, resolved, and reported.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience managing managers.
  • 10 years of experience working in data center environments, including building and operating infrastructure, network and compute architecture and lifecycle, and Linux/Unix system administration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with initiating and executing initiatives in a global environment.
  • Track record of leading and improving Environmental Health and Safety initiatives.
  • Demonstrate the ability to implement and drive the safety culture at the site, while fostering collaborative team environment
  • Excellent strategic problem-solving skills.

title: Software Engineer III, Security/Privacy, Google Cloud

title: Software Engineer, Google Payments, Growth
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. You will work on the engineering workstreams for global growth initiatives, from real-time decisioning pipelines and financial rewards settlement to stateful quest engines and low-latency signal aggregation and build features on Payment surfaces to enable growth constructs. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.

Implement stateful milestone quest engines and gamified reward mechanics that drive sustainable user engagement and positive unit economics.
  • Leverage modern Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted development tools and best practices to accelerate team-wide development velocity, test coverage, and code maintainability.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience with distributed relational databases (e.g., Spanner, SQL), schema lifecycle management, transaction isolation, and idempotency patterns.
  • Experience in Consumer Payments, loyalty/reward platforms, promotional voucher systems, or large-scale growth/conversion funnel optimization.
  • Demonstrated interest and practical experience in utilizing modern AI-powered development tools to enhance software engineering workflows.
  • Familiarity with large-scale experimentation platforms, counterfactual evaluation, and collaborating with Data Scientists to measure incremental user behavior.

title: Senior Counsel and Manager, Content Advisory
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Counsel and Manager of Regulatory Affairs, Content Advisory in APAC, you’ll be leading an APAC team responsible for advising on critical risks pertaining to content, AI and consumer protection laws, leading engagement strategy for the key regulators within those areas and providing advice across the company on compliance strategies on all regulations in those fields. You'll work closely with GAPP, Compliance and regional legal teams, supporting the shaping of law and with Google and other Alphabet companies’ Product and Engineering teams to help ensure compliance.

You will lead our engagement efforts across APAC with relevant regulators and work cross-functionally across regions to ensure consistency and cohesion across a wealth of issues. You will also lead content risk leads interactions with Product and Engineering teams to translate legislation, and other obligations into design ideas to ensure compliance across a widening set of content, AI and consumer protection regulations. You will provide legal advice and subject matter insights to varied legal and non-legal internal teams while reviewing proposed product designs, and advise teams on risks that arise during implementation, and on product launches and business deals to help assess and navigate regulatory risks. Additionally, you will develop our team structure to ensure exceptional performance and strong and trusted relationships within Alphabet. You will partner with regional teams to provide support and advice for regulatory engagement globally.

20th century laws don't always solve 21st century problems, and Google Legal crafts innovative approaches for working with some of the toughest legal challenges of the information age. Whether you're a patent attorney, an intellectual property expert or an engineer headed to law school, Google Legal lets you address unanswered legal quandaries and create new precedents. Our innovative services raise challenging questions that demand creative and practical answers. We provide those answers by working at the crossroads of the law and new technology, helping Google build innovative and important products for users around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Interpret laws and other compliance obligations into requirements for Compliance, Business, Product, and Engineering teams. Provide legal advice on compliance programs and policies to help mitigate risk.
  • Lead government and regulator discussions, negotiations, and disclosures on compliance readiness efforts.
  • Lead team and set the engagement strategy to best defend the company and advance proactive positions. Guide and manage a growing and dynamic team.
  • Support GAPP on shaping new laws in Content, AI and Consumer Protection. Work with cross-functional teams on launch and product advice. Work with Legal, RCI and Policy stakeholders to deliver engagement and compliance.
  • Collaborate efectively with global content team and RA counterparts to support driving defensible compliance positions, counsel launches, build effective programs and coherent engagement programs.

Minimum qualifications:

  • JD, LL.B., equivalent degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Admitted to the bar and in good standing or otherwise authorized to practice law (e.g., have registered in-house status) in the state in which the position is located.
  • 10 years of attorney-level experience in government, in-house, or at a law firm.
  • Experience managing teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10 years of experience with legal, regulatory or corporate compliance, including strategically addressing, minimizing and avoiding regulatory risk.
  • Expereince engaging with content, consumer and AI regulators across APAC.
  • Experience developing, evaluating, and maintaining programs that ensure products comply with laws, regulations, and external commitments.
  • Experience working with technology companies and ability to understand complex technical issues.
  • Experience working with public company boards and their counsel, including special committees and audit committees.

title: Senior Interaction Designer, Access Everywhere
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products.

The Access Everywhere (AEv) team builds the core authentication, authorization, and sign-in experiences that anchor Google's ecosystem across first-party products and third-party (3P) websites and applications.

As we enter an agentic era where autonomous AI agents, non-deterministic interfaces, ambient computing, and delegated actions re-shape digital interactions, sign-in and identity permissioning must evolve. The Senior Interaction Designer for Access Everywhere will collaborate with key partners on developing and/or evolving concepts for how users authenticate, delegate authority, and manage credentials safely and effortlessly.

This role focuses on envisioning next-generation identity concepts, creating high-impact pitches in a fast-paced environment, and modernizing foundational third-party identity journeys and the developer experience to support AI-driven delegation and contextual authentication.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Envision forward-looking UX concepts for third-party identity and the developer experience. Create prototypes and narrative storyboards to align cross-functional leaders around next-generation AI paradigms.
  • Redesign and scale existing authentication flows to balance user velocity with enterprise-grade privacy and security.
  • Architect state-aware interaction models for AI-driven delegation, enabling users to grant contextual, scoped, and time-bound permissions to agents interacting with 3P services.
  • Partner closely with UX, Product, Engineering, and Research to translate complex backend protocols into intuitive, seamless user journeys.
  • Identify emerging UX patterns and integration frameworks to ensure consistent, trustworthy Google authentication experiences across Google and external platforms.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of interaction design experience in product design or UX design.
  • Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.
  • Experience designing for AI-assisted workflows, conversational interfaces, non-deterministic UIs, or delegated authorization systems.
  • Experience driving design alignment across large, multi-disciplinary organizations with competing priorities and strict privacy/security mandates.
  • Experience designing for both enterprise and consumer-facing products.
  • Knowledge of identity/security paradigms and 3P developer ecosystem needs.
  • Ability to synthesize ambiguous technical requirements into compelling user-centric narratives and present strategic concepts to senior engineering and product executives.

title: Research Engineer, Chemical, Biological and Nuclear AI Safety, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
Google’s Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives team in Responsible Frontier Artificial Intelligence Research makes sure that as Gemini gets better at science, it does not become a tool for catastrophic harm. We are a team of engineers working alongside biologists, chemists, and physicists. Deep expertise in one field is plenty; nobody on the team covers all of them. In this role, you will do applied research, write production code, and launch the resulting safeguards to billions of users.

This role is probably not for you if you want to publish most of what you do, or if you are looking for a policy or purely research position. Expect strict data managing, tight release timelines, and an on-call rotation. You will read and debate technical material about mass-casualty harm and how to prevent it. You will dig into the small discrepancies that hint at big problems. One week you might design new safeguards; the next, find out why an evaluation result looked too good to be true, or attack our safeguards before someone else does.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Kỹ sư quản lý độ tin cậy của phần cứng
descriptionHtml:
Tham gia đội ngũ tiên phong chịu trách nhiệm phát triển các giải pháp silicon tuỳ chỉnh để định hình tương lai cho các sản phẩm Google phân phối trực tiếp tới người tiêu dùng. Bạn sẽ đóng góp vào quá trình cải tiến để tạo ra những sản phẩm được hàng triệu người trên toàn thế giới yêu thích. Kiến thức chuyên môn của bạn sẽ góp phần định hình thế hệ trải nghiệm phần cứng tiếp theo, mang đến hiệu năng, hiệu suất và khả năng tích hợp vượt trội.

Khi đảm nhận vai trò Kỹ sư về độ tin cậy, bạn sẽ góp phần quan trọng vào việc tạo ra các sản phẩm điện tử tiêu dùng mới, đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn cao về độ tin cậy và hiệu suất. Bạn sẽ phối hợp chặt chẽ cùng các nhóm kỹ thuật thiết kế và quản lý sản phẩm để xác định tiêu chuẩn, chỉ định quy trình thử nghiệm, sau đó giám sát quá trình thử nghiệm và phân tích lỗi. Đồng thời, bạn sẽ cần sử dụng chuyên môn kỹ thuật sâu rộng và vận dụng thành thạo các phương pháp thống kê cho quá trình thiết kế sản phẩm mới. Kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt sẽ là yếu tố then chốt giúp đảm bảo những đề xuất kỹ thuật mà bạn đưa ra sẽ được áp dụng.

Nhóm Nền tảng và Thiết bị phụ trách các nền tảng phần mềm điện toán khác nhau của Google trên nhiều môi trường (máy tính, thiết bị di động, ứng dụng), cũng như các thiết bị và dịch vụ do Google trực tiếp phát triển, kết hợp tối ưu AI, phần mềm và phần cứng của Google. Các nhóm trong lĩnh vực này nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ mới nhằm giúp người dùng tương tác với công nghệ điện toán nhanh và liền mạch hơn, đồng thời mang đến trải nghiệm đột phá cho người dùng trên khắp thế giới.

Responsibilities

  • Xác định kế hoạch, phương pháp xác thực độ tin cậy và thúc đẩy quá trình thực hiện thử nghiệm độ tin cậy, Phân tích lỗi (FA) của sản phẩm.

  • Đẩy mạnh hoạt động giữa các phòng ban nhằm rút ngắn thời gian đưa ra các biện pháp khắc phục hiệu quả.

title: Practice Customer Engineer, Migrations, Infrastructure and App
descriptionHtml:
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Practice Customer Engineer (CE) with a specialty in infrastructure migrations, you will partner with Technical Sales teams and other CEs to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as a technical expert and accelerate technical wins for the migration of enterprise workloads, in partnership with platform CEs, Google Cloud Consulting, and partners. You will direct migrating pilot workloads as proof-of-concepts and demos to sell complex migrations of large enterprise workloads to customers. You will solve migration-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence customers, partners and product development.

You will have excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills, engaging with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and present solutions to facilitate and de-risk the migration to Google Cloud. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and experience with technical engagement to prove the differentiating value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical win for complex enterprise workloads, engage in current state discovery and design end-state, modern cloud solutions with compelling technical value to motivate rapid and successful migration, primarily supporting the sales cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
  • Collaborate with our sales team to orchestrate winning strategies, translate business requirements to technical solutions, deliver the development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
  • Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships.
  • Leverage learnings from customer engagements to build reusable solutions and assets with the Go-To-Market team.
  • Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience with enterprise architectures and migration strategies for technologies such as Oracle, VMware, or SAP.
  • Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
  • Experience in building product demonstrations and prototypes as part of a technical workshop or executive briefing.
  • Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with data centers consolidation, relocation, migration, or virtualization projects.
  • Experience in migrating, architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems.
  • Experience in configuration management (e.g., Puppet, Chef, CFEngine, Salt), and functional operations of server, storage, and network functions.
  • Experience with networking concepts (e.g., Routing, VPNs, load balancers, and firewalls).
  • Experience migrating Linux workloads across private, public, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience with enterprise approaches for business continuity, disaster recovery, and backup and restore.

title: Senior Accelerators Systems Software Architect, AI Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our team develops the node and distributed system software, firmware, tools, and testing frameworks essential for integrating Accelerators—such as GPUs, TPUs, and Video Transcoder Accelerators—into the Google Data Center). By supporting these and other emerging domain-specific systems, we enable machine learning and high-performance workloads for both internal services like Gemini and YouTube, and for Google Cloud customers.

This senior software engineering position offers a unique opportunity to influence the entire stack, from the hardware-software interface and computer architecture to the deployment of advanced AI systems. In this role, you will be a versatile engineer with deep expertise in how workloads utilize accelerators and a strong focus on quality and reliability throughout the manufacturing and deployment life-cycle.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership on high-impact projects, anchoring the architecture and engineering roadmap of common software for Accelerator platforms.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain large-scale software solutions, including board and chip firmware and Linux kernel drivers.
  • Interface and drive industry ecosystem engagement related to various technology standards for modern Accelerator platforms.
  • Facilitate and drive AI transformation across Accelerator software teams by leveraging the latest AI tools to speed up design and development.
  • Influence and coach a distributed team of engineers while managing project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience programming in C++.
  • 5 years of experience with design and architecture; and testing/launching software products.
  • Experience integrating Generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows.
  • Experience with architecture and writing software that interacts with hardware.
  • Experience with data center servers and AI platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
  • Experience with Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) or other high-speed IO protocols and ML SOC architecture.

title: Staff AI Methodology Design/CAD Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As part of our team you'll have opportunities to participate in advancing AI for Chip Design. Automating the chip design workflow is a huge test that can transform the EDA industry. Our opportunity is to build such capabilities, and pioneer next-generation products in collaboration with teams spanning major Product Areas. In this role, you will bring the most advanced ML models and technologies to chip design. Enable efficiency across the entire AI learning stack. Scale and harden research prototypes into tools that serve chip design across Google. Engage and work in a fast paced, rapidly shifting environment, demonstrating flexibility and the ability to bring clarity in ambiguous problem spaces.

The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune AI agents by refining prompt strategies, toolsets, core skills, and model selection.
  • Design and build CAD tools and integrated workflows that allow AI agents to seamlessly interact with EDA software and design data.
  • Partner with design teams and CAD flow leads across projects to pinpoint complex design hurdles and evaluate AI integration opportunities.
  • Develop evaluation datasets and quality metrics, executing model evaluations to uncover agent failure modes.
  • Assess vendor EDA AI tools and benchmark them against internal proprietary solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience using scripting languages specifically Python, Tcl, and Unix Shell to architect automation tools and infrastructure.
  • Experience with standard ASIC flows and Chip EDA tools.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Proficiency with modern revision control systems, such as Git.

title: Product Finance Analyst, Search+
descriptionHtml:
Business Finance provides financial and analytical support and advice to Google’s Global Business Organization (GBO). Our work is integral to the strategy and operations of the commercial teams across all our advertising products. From understanding market and usage trends to exploring the productivity and return of our various investments, the Business Finance organization is an important partner and independent advisor to the commercial leaders in our company.

The EMEA GBO Product Finance team are subject matter experts in Google’s Ads Products and horizontals including Verticals and Agency. We shape regional Ads strategy and empower leaders across EMEA to navigate the fast evolving ads landscape to maximize value for customers, partners, and Google.

In this role, you will deploy strong problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to deliver actionable insights and quantitative analyses that support key business decisions. You will bring a solid understanding of Search Ads mechanics and its commercial value propositions, combined with an eagerness to learn and innovate. By actively integrating AI and automation into your daily workflow—streamlining reporting, optimizing data pipelines, and augmenting financial models—you will drive operational efficiency and unlock capacity for in-depth search. Responsibilities

Deliver investigative insights to inform decision-making, helping stakeholders understand key business drivers, product trends, risks, and performance opportunities.
  • Monitor business performance trends, distilling massive, complex datasets into clear executive narratives, actionable risk-mitigation strategies, and visual dashboards for leadership team forums.
  • Leverage advanced AI tools and modern workflow automation to optimize financial data pipelines, while building deep, specialized domain expertise in Search commercial mechanics.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Familiarity with predictive modeling, forecasting techniques, or decomposition frameworks.
  • Ability to work with data to produce analysis, influencing decision making with numerical analysis and generating insights.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work with a wide variety of departments.

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Network Delivery Implementation
descriptionHtml:
As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

The Network Delivery Implementation team builds and operates the future of Google's global network, connecting billions of users to our expanding services and enabling the world's imagination with dependable, universal connectivity. We own the full network lifecycle in our data centers and metro points of presence, driving continuous reliability, efficiency, and rapid service activation to meet the ever-growing demands of a connected world, with the goal to make connectivity ubiquitous between every machine and every user on the Internet.

In this role, you will be a key contributor as a member of the Global Network Delivery team, directly impacting Google's ability to deliver network capacity to its customers. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of network delivery through automation and process innovation. Teamwork, collaboration, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to challenging the status quo are essential for success in this role.

Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and audit of installation technicians for rack, stack and installation of networking equipment.
  • Commission and test routers, optical transport equipment, and other network devices in new and existing network nodes across Google's global network.
  • Generate implementation plans and provide technical leadership and guidance during deployment activities.
  • Work closely with project management, network engineering and rest of the engineering team to identify in advance potential problems in network installations, including in the areas of facility power (AC/DC), cooling, security/access, rack layout and cable management.
  • Own network documentation, updating and maintaining network drawings and plans.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Network or Telecom Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in DWDM or TCP/IP or system design operations methodology.
  • Experience interpreting and validating deployment packages (including orders and construction specs), verifying design accuracy, and escalating discrepancies to engineering partners.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in one or more of the following disciplines: Layer 1 optical transmissions systems, layer 3 routing TCP/IP, wireless networking, network design, or operations.
  • Experience identifying recurring errors in deployment packages or specifications and driving feedback loops to improve design accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting, or SQL to query databases and track deployment consistency, and Linux experience (i.e., run commands, move directories).

title: Data Center Server Operations Site Lead
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As a Hardware Operations Manager, you will manage a team of Data Center Technicians. You will oversee the quality installation of server hardware and components and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.

Your team will install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). They will also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. They may lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

title: User Experience Design Intern, Summer 2027, YouTube UX
descriptionHtml:
The YouTube User Experience (UX) team is a multi-disciplinary community of designers, user researchers, content strategists, motion designers, and design technologists. Together, we power experiences used by over two billion monthly viewers and millions of creative creators globally across mobile, web, living room devices, and emerging platforms.

Our goal is to make video accessible, engaging, and valuable for everyone, everywhere. We believe that thoughtful design can bridge cultures, amplify voices, and build meaningful digital communities.

At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

title: Data Cloud Sales Specialist, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As an Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialist, you will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) growth. You will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data and AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization. You will be a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, Chief Data Officer (CDO), Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO), and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (e.g., Return on Investment/Total Cost of Ownership (ROI/TCO) reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (e.g., BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver strategic business outcomes and growth goals while achieving or exceeding your sales quota. Drive net-new greenfield logos and new workloads in existing accounts through proactive engagement.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.
  • Engage C-level, Lines of Business and IT teams, through value-selling, tying modern Data and AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.
  • Align cross-functionally with Field Sales Representatives (FSRs) and Partners to execute joint Data and AI sales plays to scale success and GCP data adoption, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.
  • Whiteboard end-to-end modern data architectures including but not limited to BigQuery, Spark, Spanner and AlloyDB to demonstrate how unified data foundations power optimized -price-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with quota-carrying enterprise sales.
  • 5 years of experience leading enterprise data modernization, cloud data warehousing (e.g., Online Analytical Processing (OLAP)), or data platform migrations.
  • Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.
  • Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).
  • Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or Generative AI (GenAI) platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.
  • Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.
  • Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation agreements within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).
  • Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

title: Data Center Services Manager

title: Media Manager
descriptionHtml:

The Operational Excellence (OpsEx) team is a critical pillar of our Trust and Safety Compute organization, enabling developer experience and platform safety through AI driven operations portfolio management.

As a Policy Lifecycle Management Lead in Google Play Trust and Safety Operational Excellence, you will lead the end-to-end governance, process framework, and operational execution of our policy lifecycle—from initial intake triggers through post-launch observability and tuning. Partnering closely with Product Management (PM), Legal, Policy, Quality, and Operations teams, you will serve as the chief orchestrator translating regulatory mandates, product requests, threat escalations, and industry standards into rigorously validated, scalable operational workflows.

You will govern both qualitative and quantitative business ratification and lead executive decision gates (SteerCos) to ensure cross-functional alignment and operational readiness. You will guide executive decision-makers through complex policy design trade-offs, overseeing sandbox testing, red teaming, and quality enforcement frameworks prior to launch. Combining strong business acumen, quantitative modeling (evaluating Cost of Google Services and Developer ROI), and executive presence, you will establish integrated launch workstreams and continuous real-time telemetry feedback loops that safeguard user trust and optimize developer experience.

title: Community Development Manager, Strategic Partnership Office
descriptionHtml:
Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As our products and services scale globally, we work behind the scenes to secure infrastructure to build Google's future. The Strategic Partnership Office (SPO) operates at the intersection of industrial innovation, external affairs, and civic impact, bridging Google’s technology capabilities with real-world partners. Within SPO, the Economic and Community Development team is a vertically integrated organization responsible for analyzing and mitigating economic, community, and labor risks to deliver an optimized inventory of assets meeting business operating needs, ensuring growth and resilience through place-based strategies. We provide hyperlocal civic impact, community sustainability, and external engagement strategies, programs, and tools to expand economic, community, and workforce development outcomes.

The Community Development and Engagement (CDE) team drives business value by: 1) accelerating new technical infrastructure delivery and growth; 2) protecting Google’s license to operate globally; and 3) leveraging community partnerships and innovative expertise to deliver impactful solutions.

In this role, you will combine community engagement and industry knowledge to support Google’s infrastructure growth in Belgium. This role supports SPO’s strategic goals by providing data-driven insights and executing programmatic engagement based on community assessments across existing and prospective data center markets. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive measurable social impact, cultivate relationships with key opinion formers (KOFs), government officials, and community leaders, and research new in-market opportunities. Additionally, you will help entrench community development best practices across a rapidly growing organization, serving as a subject matter expert on data center delivery and strategic community engagement.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Netherlands: €124000 - €127000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead global data center community development strategies, investments, and impact for the Netherlands.
  • Engage with key opinion formers, community groups such as municipal leaders, industry partners, economic development organizations, schools, education institutions, and non-profits.
  • Collaborate with team leaders and peers to develop strategies to scale sub-regional Community Affairs coverage in emerging markets, focusing on place-based frameworks and partnerships to produce location-specific development plans based on research data turned into actionable insights to prioritize community needs.
  • Develop communication tools and processes to educate local communities about the role and impact of our data centers, and create locally focused self-sustaining investment plans.
  • Build and maintain key internal relationships with a set of internal stakeholders, including Acquisition and Development, Energy, Government Affairs and Public Policy, Cloud Supply Chain and Operations, Marketing, Google, and local Google data center teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program or project management.
  • Experience working with local municipalities, associations, key opinion formers, non-profit decision makers, education institutions, and community members.
  • Ability to travel 25% of the time as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Education, Public Relations/Policy or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using analytics to make decisions.
  • Experience developing and launching local, state, national or global public-private partnerships.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: Data Centers, Utilities, Government, Advanced Manufacturing.
  • Ability to grow in a fluid multinational environment working across multiple lines of business.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Dutch fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

title: Data Cloud Sales Specialist, Google Cloud (Japanese)
descriptionHtml:
As an Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (e.g., Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our Partners to help our customers modernize their operational and investigative data foundations on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position Data as the absolute foundation for Artificial Intelligence (AI) success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications.

In this role, you will translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes. You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. You will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data and AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, Chief Data Officer (CDO), Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO), and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to discover critical pain points, build business cases (e.g., Return on Investment/Total Cost of Ownership (ROI/TCO) reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP. You will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (e.g., BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.
  • Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data and AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.
  • Align cross-functionally with Field Sales Representatives (FSRs) and Partners to execute joint Data and AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.
  • Whiteboard modern architectures (e.g., BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in quota-carrying enterprise sales.
  • Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.
  • Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).
  • Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.
  • Ability to communicate in Japanese fluently to manage stakeholder relationships.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or Generative AI (GenAI) platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.
  • Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.
  • Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).
  • Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

title: Quantitative UX Researcher, Customer Engagement
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a Quantitative User Experience Researcher (Quant UXR), you make this possible. You will join a multi-disciplinary team, collaborating closely with Engineering and Product Management to create industry-leading, innovative products.

You will drive impact at all stages of development by investigating user behavior through empirical methods like logs analysis, survey research, and regression. We value diverse educational experiences—from Computer Science to Psychology—and require a blend of behavioral research design, statistical proficiency, and programming skills to uncover actionable insights. Beyond the work, you will grow within a supportive Quant UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools to help you thrive.

Our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform powers Google Ads Sales. As we transform the platform with agentic AI, we are building intelligent workflows that route, synthesize, and resolve complex seller and advertiser tasks across general and specialized agents. In this role, you will define the measurement frameworks and behavioral models behind how users interact with multi-agent systems. You will help answer critical platform-level questions surrounding routing efficiency, AI quality calibration, and human-in-the-loop patterns to improve the overall product experience.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define and measure quantitative UX goals and metrics in collaboration with designers, qualitative researchers, data scientists, engineers and program managers.
  • Design and analyze human and synthetic evaluation systems for multi-agent workflows, applying crossed rater/item statistical models to calibrate routing quality and mitigate rater bias.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B experiments to measure the impact of product changes on user behavior and key metrics.
  • Partner with designers, qualitative researchers, data scientists, engineers, and program managers to define user-centered success metrics and ensure appropriate data instrumentation.
  • Translate complex findings into actionable insights and communicate them effectively to cross-functional stakeholders to drive research that improves the user experience.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience in product research in an applied research setting, or similar.
  • Experience in programming languages used for data manipulation and computational statistics (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, C++, Java, or Go).
  • Experience applying statistical modeling, including mixed-effects and item response modeling, to behavioral data.
  • Experience in experimental design and survey research instrument design for evaluating systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or related field.
  • 5 years of experience conducting UX research on products and working with executive leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
  • 3 years of experience managing projects, and working in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Experience analyzing user behavior in Business-to-Business (B2B) contexts, enterprise software, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, or support tooling.
  • Experience evaluating multi-agent architectures, agentic workflows, orchestrators, or subagent routing systems.

descriptionHtml:
Cho dù phụ trách một sản phẩm tiêu dùng (như Gmail, Tìm kiếm, Maps, Chrome, Android) hay một sản phẩm kinh doanh (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), bạn đều đóng góp vào một trải nghiệm tiếp thị hoàn chỉnh qua việc dẫn dắt mọi khía cạnh của hành trình sản phẩm. Bắt đầu từ khâu định vị, đặt tên, phân tích khả năng cạnh tranh, ưu tiên tính năng cho đến truyền thông đối ngoại, bạn sẽ góp phần định hình sản phẩm và giúp tăng trưởng số lượng người tiêu dùng. Theo đó, bạn sẽ làm việc với một phòng ban liên ngành trong các lĩnh vực bán hàng, truyền thông doanh nghiệp, pháp chế, quản trị trang web, phát triển sản phẩm, kỹ thuật, cùng nhiều lĩnh vực khác. Khi đảm nhiệm vai trò này, bạn sẽ tham gia vào việc xây dựng chiến lược tiếp thị sản phẩm từ đầu đến cuối.

Khi đảm nhiệm vai trò này, bạn sẽ chịu trách nhiệm dẫn dắt các sáng kiến của Google nhằm thúc đẩy nền kinh tế số phát triển, đảm bảo sự an toàn cho người dùng và củng cố vị thế thương hiệu của Google trong hệ sinh thái kỹ thuật số tại Đông Nam Á và các thị trường mới nổi ở Nam Á (SAF) cũng như đối với những người có tầm ảnh hưởng lớn tại quốc gia này. Bạn sẽ nắm vững hệ sinh thái kỹ thuật số ở thị trường SAF và phối hợp với nhóm để xác định những sáng kiến phù hợp sẽ mang lại tác động tích cực cho hoạt động kinh doanh (B2B và B2C) và danh tiếng. Bạn sẽ ra mắt các chương trình, xây dựng mối quan hệ đối tác và tạo chiến dịch tiếp thị nhằm đưa những ý tưởng này vào thực tế. Đây là một vai trò năng động và mang tinh thần làm chủ, đòi hỏi nhiều kỹ năng về mảng tiếp thị/xây dựng thương hiệu, khả năng lãnh đạo vận hành mạnh mẽ cũng như khả năng thúc đẩy mối quan hệ đối tác bền vững cả nội bộ lẫn bên ngoài.

Hiểu rõ người dùng. Hiểu rõ giải pháp. Kết nối người dùng và giải pháp. Về bản chất, hoạt động tiếp thị tại Google bắt đầu từ công nghệ và kết thúc ở người dùng, kết nối cả hai theo những cách độc đáo. Công việc của chúng tôi là chứng minh cách sản phẩm của Google có thể giải quyết vấn đề trên thế giới: từ những điều nhỏ bé thường nhật cho đến thách thức lớn lao, từ những điều bình thường đến những vấn đề có tầm vóc vĩ đại. Đồng thời, chúng tôi tiếp cận hoạt động tiếp thị theo cách mà chỉ Google mới làm được – thay đổi cuộc chơi, tái định hình phương tiện, ưu tiên người dùng, và rồi để công nghệ tự chứng tỏ khả năng.

Responsibilities

  • Khám phá thông tin chuyên sâu về người dùng, nhà quảng cáo, người có tầm ảnh hưởng lớn và hệ sinh thái quảng cáo kỹ thuật số để hỗ trợ việc lên các sáng kiến và chiến lược truyền thông.
  • Dẫn dắt hoạt động ra mắt sản phẩm và chương trình mới: từ xây dựng khái niệm, lập chiến lược, đến thực thi sáng kiến, bản địa hoá nội dung, tạo dựng quan hệ đối tác, truyền thông, thực hiện kế hoạch và các chiến dịch nâng cao thương hiệu tích hợp. 
  • Thấm nhuần và đưa thương hiệu, sứ mệnh và các giá trị của Google vào thực tiễn bằng một câu chuyện thống nhất xoay quanh cam kết của Google đối với quốc gia này xuyên suốt các sáng kiến được ra mắt.
  • Làm việc sát sao, phối hợp, hướng dẫn và tạo ảnh hưởng đến các phòng ban liên ngành có liên quan để đảm bảo mang lại tác động cao nhất cho thương hiệu Google. Quản lý công ty quảng cáo và đối tác bên ngoài để xây dựng và thực thi các chương trình, đồng thời thực hiện hiệu quả mục tiêu của chiến dịch và mục tiêu kinh doanh.
  • Hỗ trợ truyền đạt thông tin ở cấp lãnh đạo trong bộ phận tiếp thị và với các phòng ban liên ngành khác.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 4 năm kinh nghiệm trong hoạt động tiếp thị, làm việc trong ít nhất một lĩnh vực tiếp thị (cụ thể là tăng trưởng, tiếp thị sản phẩm, tiếp thị thương hiệu, mạng xã hội).
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng tiếng Anh và một trong các ngôn ngữ sau: tiếng Việt, tiếng Thái hoặc tiếng Bahasa Indonesia để hỗ trợ việc quản lý quan hệ khách hàng ở khu vực này.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc tại công ty tiếp thị, công ty quảng cáo hoặc công ty tư vấn quản lý.
  • Hiểu rõ về các sản phẩm của Google và ngành công nghệ.
  • Hiểu rõ về công nghệ, sáng tạo, có khả năng tư duy đột phá và triển khai công việc hiệu quả bằng năng lực lãnh đạo.
  • Có khả năng đạt được mục tiêu đề ra, phát triển và hiểu rõ chiến lược.
  • Xuất sắc trong kỹ năng xác định và giải quyết vấn đề theo chiến lược.

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Network Delivery Implementation
descriptionHtml:
As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

As a part of the Network Delivery Implementation team, you will build and operate the future of Google's global network, connecting billions of users to our expanding services and enabling the world's imagination with dependable, universal connectivity. You will own the full network life-cycle in our data centers and metro points of presence, driving continuous reliability, efficiency, and rapid service activation to meet the ever-growing demands of a connected world, with the goal to make connectivity ubiquitous between every machine and every user on the Internet.

You will be a key contributor as a member of the Global Network Delivery team, directly impacting Google's ability to deliver network capacity to its customers. Your role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of network delivery through automation and process innovation. Teamwork, collaboration, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to challenging the status quo are essential for success in this role.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life-cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee QA of installation technicians for rack, stack and installation of networking equipment.
  • Commission and test routers, optical transport equipment, and other network devices in new and existing network nodes across Google's global network.
  • Develop implementation plans and provide technical leadership and guidance during deployment activities.
  • Work closely with project management, network engineering and rest of the engineering team to identify in advance potential problems in network installations, including in the areas of facility power (AC/DC), cooling, security/access, rack layout and cable management.
  • Maintain network documentation, updating and maintaining network drawings and plans.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Network or Telecom Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in carrier-class environments, with technical experience in both Layer 1 physical infrastructure (DWDM, AC/DC power, OSP/ISP).
  • Experience interpreting and validating deployment packages (including orders and construction specs) to verify design accuracy and escalating discrepancies to engineering partners before installation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in one or more of the following disciplines: Layer 1 optical transmissions systems, layer 3 routing TCP/IP, wireless networking, network design, or operations.
  • Experience identifying recurring errors in deployment packages or specifications and driving feedback loops to improve design accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting, or SQL to query databases and track deployment consistency. Basic Linux experience (ie run commands, move directories).
  • Proven ability to lead technical projects and troubleshoot complex field deployments alongside data center technicians and third party vendors, ensuring installation quality and resolving on-site technical blockers to meet timelines

title: Strategy and Operations Manager, Global Ads and Commerce Marketing
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you will be working alongside to the team that leads Ads Product Marketing (APM), and will act as a key strategic thought partner to the Ads Product Marketing and the overall Ads and Commerce organization.

This role sits at the center of Google’s Ads Product Marketing organization—spanning Search and Agentic AI, GenMedia/Creative, Measurement, GMP and Sellside managing high-impact strategic and operational initiatives that bridge upstream product strategy with downstream commercial execution. You will orchestrate strategic business planning (including product strategy synthesis, headcount/resource alignment, and C-suite-ready executive narratives and reviews) and help drive product readiness for flagship global tentpoles (such as Google Marketing Live and Rethink Week).

You will define and operationalize cross-functional operating models and governance frameworks across Product Marketing (PMM), Product Management (PM), GBO, and GTM teams and help streamline workflows. You will be at the forefront of Marketing’s AI transformation and develop plans to drive business impact with the latest Google technology and innovations.

Leveraging strong strategic acumen, operational excellence, and executive presence, you will solve complex, ambiguous challenges and align senior stakeholders across PAs. In return, the role provides exceptional visibility, direct partnership with Google’s senior leadership, and high impact potential.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $116000 - $166000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the rhythm of the business for Ads product marketing leadership, including executive reviews, cross-product area alignment forums, leadership offsites, performance/OKR tracking, and organization-wide communications.
  • Orchestrate annual and multi-year strategic planning cycles, synthesizing product priorities across Ads pillars into cohesive executive narratives, leadership review materials, and organizational resource plans.
  • Partner with teams to pilot, operationalize, and support AI-driven tools and workflows across marketing.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in management consulting, sales strategy and operations, go-to-market strategy, business operations, product marketing strategy, or corporate strategy.
  • 2 years of experience managing cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, or Sales/Go-To-Market stakeholders.
  • 2 years of experience working with executive stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to solve complex, multi-layered problems and streamline business or development workflows.
  • Understanding of B2B product marketing work, commercial go-to-market (GTM) motions, and sales enablement workflows within a technology or digital advertising organization.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, structuring new processes, and running the operational cadence for senior leadership.
  • Ability to synthesize complex product strategies and quantitative analyses into compelling, C-suite-ready presentations and executive briefings.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with strong business judgment and executive presence.

title: Data Scientist III, Research
descriptionHtml:
Google is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, data scientists not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another. As a Data Scientist, you will evaluate and improve Google's products. You will collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers and analysts on a wide range of problems. This position will bring scientific and statistical methods to the challenges of product creation, development and improvement with an appreciation for the behaviors of the end user.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders in cross-projects and team settings to identify and clarify business or product questions to answer. Provide feedback to translate and refine business questions into tractable analysis, evaluation metrics, or mathematical models.
  • Use custom data infrastructure or existing data models as appropriate, using specialized knowledge. Design and evaluate models to mathematically express and solve defined problems with limited precedent.
  • Gather information, business goals, priorities, and organizational context around the questions to answer, as well as the existing and upcoming data infrastructure.
  • Own the process of gathering, extracting, and compiling data across sources via relevant tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python). Independently format, re-structure, or validate data to ensure quality, and review the dataset to ensure it is ready for analysis.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a PhD degree.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a PhD degree.

title: Data Center Maintenance Planner
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.660000 - kr.675000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the flow of all maintenance work orders by working with Data Center Operations teams and vendors, planning and scheduling of resources needed to perform maintenance activities.
  • Collaborate with facility management in the development and maintenance of schedules and resource leveling by utilizing the site CMMS program.
  • Establish and maintain CMMS equipment files, parts inventory, equipment bill of materials, and PM schedules.
