As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead system software development programs, driving full stack Software (SW) development from ASIC firmware, management controller firmware, kernel driver, OS and system monitoring/management services, to integration with production cluster management and ML compiler tool chains, driving pilot criteria and workloads, to enable successful landings of TPU/GPU ML systems.
  • Lead highly cross-functional teams, navigate technical and organizational complexity to drive planning, execution and land products.
  • Navigate ambiguity to align leadership across internal and external organizations, driving consensus on complex initiatives.
  • Demonstrate ownership and deep technical judgment, identifying risks, ensuring end to end design alignment and high quality SW systems. 
  • Move beyond execution and task management to identify opportunities for process and architecture/design improvements, resolving alignment or process breakdown between organizations, defining and operationalizing process improvements and automation to achieve repeatable results.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in program management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in software engineering, preferably as a developer or development manager, with strong understanding of SW development processes, tools, SW test/qualification, release methodologies.
  • Knowledge/experience with NPI development, firmware, driving SW quality and process transformation would be a bonus but not necessary.
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully drive and land complex programs involving Hardware (HW) and SW.
  • Ability to leverage AI and automation to simplify and scale program management workflows.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and organizational skills.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Generative AI, Google Cloud (Mandarin)
descriptionHtml:
As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset, and you will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for engineering teams.
  • Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption. Translate technical concepts to non-technical and executive Mandarin-speaking audiences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development using Python or a similar coding languages.
  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch for customers.
  • Ability to communicate in Mandarin fluently in order to engage clients based in Greater China.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Experience leading technical discovery sessions.
  • Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Manager, APAC External Engagement, Platforms and Devices, Government Affairs and Public Policy
descriptionHtml:
Google’s Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) organization leads the company’s engagement with governments and relevant third parties in the formation and execution of public policy that benefits innovation and tech progress.

As a member of our organization, you will help educate policymakers and key opinion formers, advise internal teams on the political landscape, and work across Google to develop coherent, strategic plans to advocate for Google’s public policy priorities.
The GAPP Platforms and Devices Products team focuses on Android, Play, Chrome and Pixel product areas to advise on public policy issues. We work closely with PR, Marketing, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Partnerships, and other teams within GAPP to develop consistent public policy strategies and positions to share on Google’s behalf to relevant stakeholders. Our mission is to help Google, governments, and civil society responsibly navigate the social, political and economic issues of our time.

Responsibilities

  • Influence cross-organizational collaborations to align team decisions with overarching policy objectives.
  • Manage multiple complex, cross-market workstreams in support of the director.
  • Develop and lead the trade strategy for Platforms and Devices in APAC, in close coordination with Washington DC and key markets based teams.
  • Build and manage relationships with the industry stakeholders (including the US embassies in key markets), assess the need for industry associations or coalitions, and develop relevant strategic plans.
  • Create new ways to advance our equities, with a particular focus on the APAC market.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience working on technology policy issues within government, think tanks, public interest groups, law, or relevant industry associations.
  • 10 years of experience working in public affairs, political communications, or political campaigns, or within government.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA degree.
  • Government experience related to trade negotiations.
  • Experience working with or in think tanks, public interest groups, technology industry groups, or corporate public policy organizations.
  • Proven experience leading and influencing cross-functional collaborations within global teams.
  • Demonstrated expertise in political context and technology policies, with a deep understanding of Google's products and business strategy.

title: Senior Product Manager, YouTube Shorts Growth and UI Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
YouTube Shorts is one of YouTube’s fastest-growing product ecosystems, reaching billions of users globally every month. Our Growth team’s mission is to accelerate short-form video adoption and habitual engagement by optimizing the end-to-end viewer funnel across YouTube’s largest mobile discovery surfaces.

As a Senior Product Manager for YouTube Shorts Growth, you will own top-of-funnel acquisition, activation, and conversion workstreams across YouTube’s core surfaces. You will operate as a quantitative growth leader—diagnosing funnel friction, identifying immediate tactical levers, and designing self-reinforcing growth loops that convert viewer intent into active, habitual short-form viewing sessions.

In this role, you will lead the strategic vision, high-velocity experimentation roadmap, and execution of high-impact product experiences at massive scale designed to accelerate engagement. Sitting at the intersection of quantitative growth strategy, mobile UI mechanics, and cross-surface discovery, you will partner closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Data Science across multiple YouTube platform teams to rapidly test hypotheses, validate metric movers, and scale winning growth playbooks globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end user conversion funnels across YouTube’s primary surfaces into Shorts, identifying immediate, high-leverage UI and trigger tactics that maximize click-through, session activation, and viewing depth.
  • Design, test, and scale self-reinforcing growth loops, onboarding experiences, and re-engagement mechanics that convert casual or first-time viewers into habitual daily consumers.
  • Operate a rigorous, high-throughput A/B testing pipeline—rapidly translating data insights into lightweight tactical experiments to prove out metric levers before scaling long-term product investments.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to instrument granular funnel telemetry, dissect cohort-level drop-offs, and model ROI to ruthlessly prioritize tactics that move top-line engagement metrics.
  • Establish repeatable growth playbooks through cross-functional collaboration across core YouTube teams to scale winning UI patterns globally.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 4 years of experience driving consumer product growth, user acquisition, funnel conversion optimization, or end-to-end product execution.
  • Experience in product management focused on consumer mobile experiences, as well as top-of-funnel entry points or user onboarding/activation flows.
  • Experience using quantitative funnel analysis and A/B experimentation to drive growth metrics.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience as a dedicated Growth PM leading user acquisition, onboarding, funnel conversion optimization (CRO), and retention loops for large-scale consumer mobile apps or short-form video platforms.
  • Exceptional cross-functional influence and technical/design partnership skills at a senior level, with demonstrated success driving shared roadmaps across multiple partner engineering and UX teams.
  • Deep fluency in quantitative growth analytics, cohort modeling, funnel diagnostics, and scripting to independently uncover metric bottlenecks and size tactical opportunities.
  • Proven track record of "growth hacking" at scale—designing high-cadence A/B test pipelines, extracting signal from noisy experiments, and compounding incremental wins into step-change metric growth.

title: ATE Test Infrastructure Engineer, TPU Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, you will drive the post-silicon New Product Introduction (NPI) and high-volume manufacturing test strategies for Google's next-generation TPU and High-Performance Computing (HPC) products. You will develop and validate advanced Automated Test Equipment (ATE) programs, create pre-silicon test solutions, and build automated tools to optimize the entire silicon testing life-cycle.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Architecture, Design, and Verification teams to develop new product bring-up, validation, characterization, and qualification strategies, as well as manufacturing test solutions for new High Performance Computing (HPC) products in advanced process technologies.
  • Verify test solutions on pre-silicon models (simulation or emulation) and develop ATE test modules, DC tests, binning, production, and characterization flows.
  • Develop and validate test programs on Automated Test Equipment (ATE) platforms for new product integration (NPI) in preparation for high-volume manufacturing (HVM), working with ATE vendors and internal cross-functional teams.
  • Create tools, flows, and methodologies to continuously improve and automate the testing life-cycle.
  • Influence and work with upstream and downstream partners to enable automated solutions to test problems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in test engineering.
  • Experience scripting in Python or Java.
  • Experience with ATE test platforms such as the Advantest 93K and Teradyne UltraFlex SOC test systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience in pre-silicon validation, test content generation, ATE program development, and post-silicon enabling from New Product Introduction through High Volume Manufacturing.
  • Experience in creating end-to-end manufacturing test strategies for PCBA and systems that cover structural through functional and system tests.
  • Experience in C# or C/C++ is preferred.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Home Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Google Home Infrastructure team builds the platform that powers hundreds of millions of smart home devices. We connect speakers, displays, cameras, thermostats, locks, sensors, and home entertainment systems with intelligence and cloud services.

Our mission is to create a resilient, low-latency distributed backbone that turns disconnected smart devices into a unified, proactive, and assistive ecosystem. As homes transform from reactive voice commands to autonomous, multi-agent AI experiences that assist families in their daily lives, our infrastructure delivers the mission-critical distributed storage, real-time event streaming, high-throughput authorization, device lifecycle management, and agentic control planes that make it all possible at global scale.

The Google Home team focuses on hardware, software and services offerings for the home, ranging from thermostats to smart displays. The Home team researches, designs, and develops new technologies and hardware to make users’ homes more helpful. Our mission is the helpful home: to create a home that cares for the people inside it and the world around it.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Scope and execute complex, zero-downtime infrastructure migrations (e.g., cloud platform consolidation, legacy protocol sunsets), drastically reducing operational overhead and infrastructure costs.
  • Own the architectural direction and multi-quarter technical roadmap for key infrastructure components (e.g., storage platforms, device control planes, or authorization backends).
  • Lead the execution strategy for large-scale data store consolidations. Migrating legacy datastores into unified distributed stores and replacing legacy pipelines with modern event-driven architectures.
  • Partner with New Product Introduction (NPI) teams, partner platforms, and product stakeholders to drive convergence across fragmented device lifecycle systems into a single unified protocol.
  • Architect scalable, resilient authorization frameworks that uphold strict isolation between communal home state and personal user data across high-QPS production traffic.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in C++, Java, or Kotlin programming languages.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
  • 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • Experience with low-level and high-level networking protocols.
  • Experience in the smart home, IoT, or voice assistant domain.

title: Account Executive, Commerce, Mid-Market Sales, Google Customer Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As an Account Executive, you will work with your respective set of advertisers to shape their business growth and strengthen long-term relationships. You will drive scalable product adoption and business growth. You will anticipate how decisions are made at C-level, explore and uncover the business needs of customers, and understand how our range of product offerings can grow their business. You will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users, drive growth for the book of business, and win a share of wallets for Google. You will be front-line sales leads with a focused portfolio of clients, working alongside an Account Manager. You will design transformative strategies for business growth based on customer objectives.Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of businesses and develop partnerships through a comprehensive understanding of their business tests, marketing objectives, and success metrics.
  • Lead C-level relationships with customers and agencies, and serve as a trusted advisor identifying opportunities for multi-quarter business growth.
  • Build an in-depth knowledge of how Google advertising products work and can be used to help meet a wide range of marketing objectives, and drive adoption of key product best practices.
  • Collaborate within the team, and cross-functionally to execute plans and ensure accountability to meet or exceed goals.
  • Develop and refine a point of view to scale product, processes, and align priorities to drive customer growth, and help scale best practices to contribute to overall team success.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in digital advertising, consultative sales, business development, or digital marketing, working with advertisers, agencies, or clients in India.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Ability to build strategic partnerships through strong business understanding, relationship building, and competitive solution-led selling.
  • Ability to think strategically about complex issues to develop recommendations and compelling narratives to exhibit thought leadership within the digital marketing space.
  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.
  • Ability to travel for customer meetings as needed, up to 10-20% of the time.

title: Research Engineer, Biosecurity, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

The GDM Biosecurity Initiative aims to leverage AI to proactively mitigate risks from biological threats, including those from nature or from intentional misuse of AI-enabled tools. The team conducts foundational biosecurity research across a range of topics, assists in biosecurity risk assessments of specialized science models, and engages with the broader AI biosecurity ecosystem.

As a research engineer on the biosecurity initiative, you will combine frontier ML research with software engineering best practices to build tools, models, and evaluation methodologies to mitigate biological risks. You will collaborate closely with research scientists and engineers to shape the research roadmap for the biosecurity initiative, specifically influencing data curation, scaling, infrastructure, and model development to accelerate efforts within the biosecurity portfolio aligned as required to support the initiative in collaboration with the team.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement novel algorithms and machine-learning (ML) methods to address core biosecurity research questions.
  • Contribute to pioneering research on AI and biosecurity, supporting scientific publications and product development aligned with the Biosecurity initiative mission.
  • Collaborate with research scientists and engineers across the initiative and Science and Strategic Initiatives unit to prototype, experiment, and scale AI research using software engineering best practices.
  • Contribute to the design of biological datasets, evaluation methodologies, and infrastructure required to pursue novel research hypotheses.
  • Synthesize complex research findings into clear, actionable reports and presentations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, delivered through written documentation and verbal briefings.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with machine learning algorithms and tools (e.g., TensorFlow, Pytorch).

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience applying deep learning models to biological data (such as functional genomics or protein sequence data).
  • Experience working with life science data, such as in bioinformatics or health informatics.
  • Familiarity with emerging topics in biosecurity, such as metagenomic surveillance, de novo pathogen design, and LLM-based uplift.
  • Ability to identify, breakdown, and solve ambiguous and complex process and technical problems that span across many teams and organizations.

title: Senior Staff Research Scientist, Google Cloud AI Research

title: Distinguished Engineer, App and Ecosystem Trust
descriptionHtml:

In this role, your technical leadership and architectural influence will extend across Product Areas (PAs), partnering across Platforms & Devices (P&D) and Android Platform, and with Google Play, DeepMind (GDM), Core Security, and Google-wide AI Safety councils.

title: Global Strategy and Operations Senior Associate, YouTube Shopping
descriptionHtml:

We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. title: Senior Silicon Engineer, HBM Memory Subsystem Design, Integration and Validation
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, you will be part of a team developing ASICs used to accelerate and improve traffic efficiency in data centers. You will collaborate with members of architecture, verification, power and performance, and physical design to deliver high quality designs for next generation data center accelerators. You will solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic solutions, and evaluate design options with complexity, performance, power and area in mind.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Define microarchitecture and develop high-quality RTL for memory controller frontends, guiding implementation trade-offs across performance, area, power, timing, and configurability for multi-channel and pseudo-channel configurations.
  • Lead the design, integration, and delivery of complex memory controller backends and HBM/DDR PHY macros, owning quality closure (DFI pipe wrappers, clock/reset, PLL references, sideband bridging) and schedule from concept to tapeout.
  • Collaborate with DV teams to build test plans, improve coverage, and validate design intent (UVM, emulation, ECC/RAS error injection), while tracking JEDEC specs and memory conferences for the latest HBM trends.
  • Lead and support ATE testing, first-silicon lab bring-up, and physical characterization of the HBM PHY and controller across PVT (process, voltage, temperature) corners.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers while promoting best practices in RTL design, review, documentation, methodology, and systematic root-cause debug.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in memory subsystem design, integration or verification.
  • Experience with DRAM protocols (HBM2e/HBM3/HBM4 or DDR/LPDDR4x/5/5X) including Joint Electron Device Engineering Council (JEDEC) timing, refresh and training sequences.
  • Experience with the DFI controller-to-PHY interface, leading a feature or IP block, and mentoring engineers.
  • Experience in SystemVerilog RTL, simulation and debug flows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience delivering configurable, reusable IP-parameterization, release packaging, integration guides and customer-facing documentation.
  • Experience integrating third-party controller and PHY IP (Rambus, Cadence/Synopsys class) into production silicon.
  • Experience with SECDED per pseudo-channel, Reed–Solomon symbol correction, error queues, lane/row repair, address-folded CRC.
  • Experience with UVM methodology and emulation-based pre-silicon validation, and familiarity with memory telemetry and Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) — per-pseudo-channel counters, link availability, continuous eye-opening monitors.

title: UX Designer, Search Verticals
descriptionHtml:

You’ll always start from a user-centered app-first mindset to drive intuitive, highly engaging user journeys for our products. You’ll bring a builder's mindset with strong craft and the ability to make design decisions that result in a coherent user experience while also assessing for execution, longevity and scale of designs. You’ll have an aesthetic sensibility, understanding relevant trends to make design decisions that increase the overall appeal of our product set. You’ll be a systems thinker with the ability to analyze existing landscapes and consider how factors or components interrelate with each other and within the context of larger systems. You’ll bring AI fluency to effectively interact and prototype with AI tools, understand core AI concepts and limitations and critically assess desired outputs for accuracy.

As a UX Designer on the CoreX team, you will operate as a bridge between the established Search Design System and the nuanced needs of Search Verticals (Restaurants, Flights, Events, People, TV and Movies, Sports, etc.) to develop innovative user experiences across the core Search Results Page (SRP), AI Overviews (AIO), and AI Mode/Modules. You will directly influence how Search users access information in the AI era. Working as a horizontal designer means your work won't just impact a single feature, it will establish the foundational patterns for hundreds of products and billions of global users.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

title: Director, Technical Program Management, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization is leading an industry-defining transformation in how Google delivers technical infrastructure for the AI era. Transitioning away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass-assembled, standardized modules and off-site manufacturing.

By pushing labor-intensive assembly, systems integration, and quality testing upstream into controlled factory environments, we enable "square wave" capacity delivery—turning on gigawatt-scale AI compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, and network fabric with unprecedented velocity. Operating across AI Systems & Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems & Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our team defines the modular technical product and serves as the accountable business owner for industrializing and landing modular capacity globally.

As the Principal TPM of Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering, you will be the chief industrial architect responsible for translating Google’s modular infrastructure strategy into an executable, manufacturing reality. In this principal technical leadership role—with the charter to incubate the discipline and potentially scale a dedicated team over time—you will bridge the gap between design engineering, external contract manufacturing, and on-site field execution.

Your remit spans the entire physical and technical stack: structural modules, medium-to-low voltage power skids, liquid cooling distribution, and dense AI compute hardware. You will evaluate current field deployment and operations bottlenecks and establish scalable manufacturing processes with global contract manufacturers and fabricators. Your core mandate is simple yet radical: dramatically compress the timeline from factory gate to live AI compute, reduce complexity of assembly in manufacturing and in the field, and increase first pass yield/quality of the entire data center system.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $281000 - $391000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Formulate and drive the multi-year manufacturing and assembly roadmap for Google’s modular data center platforms, aligning complex system architectures with industrial factory capabilities.
  • Deconstruct monolithic data center systems into standardized, manufactured building blocks. Architect module boundaries across structural, cooling, power, and IT server clusters to maximize factory pre-assembly and minimize field connections.
  • Advocate for DFM/A, Design for Test (DFT), and modular interface standards upstream across Hardware Engineering, Data Center Engineering, and Infrastructure design teams, ensuring products are engineered from inception for rapid off-site assembly.
  • Dive into existing on-site data center construction, white-space fit-out, and compute commissioning processes. Identify labor-intensive operations and re-engineer them into off-site, factory-integrated steps.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of technical program management, manufacturing engineering, or industrial engineering experience spanning integrated physical/hardware systems.
  • 10 years of experience applying Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/A), Lean Manufacturing, and process optimization to electromechanical or mission-critical systems.
  • 10 years of experience working directly with external Contract Manufacturers (CMs), Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs), or specialized industrial fabricators to stand up assembly and test lines.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Research, or an MBA with a technical undergraduate degree.
  • 15 years of experience leading industrialization and manufacturing programs for low-to-mid volume, highly complex capital systems (e.g., aerospace systems integration, semiconductor capital equipment, specialized defense systems, complex power/propulsion plants, or modular high-performance compute clusters).
  • Deep technical literacy across both facility infrastructure (structural enclosures, liquid cooling loops, high-power distribution skids) and IT compute hardware (TPU/GPU server trays, rack-level integration, cabling topologies, and L11/L12 assembly).

title: SOC Quality and Reliability Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

Google’s data centers are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help build the SoC’s that power these data centers by driving quality and reliability processes from the integrated circuit perspective. You will create silicon and follow it into the field (and back) to drive improvements for the next generations of chips.

You will have an understanding of IC flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, yield, reliability, and failure analysis. You will work with various cross functional teams to develop quality and reliability specifications, develop and deploy design guidelines, and develop and execute and test plans. Within the larger organization you will collaborate with global hardware quality and reliability teams, silicon design, validation and engineering teams.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the strategic definition and development of design-for-reliability (DfR) guidelines, collaborating with cross-functional subject matter experts to integrate reliability into early design stages.
  • Define and lead the development of qualification hardware and test methodologies, managing internal teams and external vendors to ensure silicon and package verification.
  • Execute comprehensive silicon and package qualification programs (including high-temperature operating life (HTOL), early life failure rate (ELFR), electrostatic discharge/latch-up (ESD/LU), biased highly accelerated stress test (b/HAST), etc.) and conduct failure analysis to resolve quality issues.
  • Extract and analyze data from qualification programs, high-volume manufacturing, and field returns to identify failure mechanisms and trends for yield and reliability optimization.
  • Develop and implement physics-based statistical Quality and Reliability models (e.g., ELF, time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), negative bias temperature instability (NBTI) to predict device failure mechanisms and lifetime behaviors.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in IC silicon quality or reliability.
  • Experience leading the product reliability lifecycle from post-tapeout through high-volume manufacturing.
  • Experience with semiconductor complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology, device physics, and failure mechanisms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field.
  • Expertise in statistical data analysis using tools such as JMP, Python, or JSL.
  • Knowledge of design-for-reliability (DfR) rules and implementation techniques.
  • Familiarity with electrical failure analysis (EFA) and physical failure analysis (PFA) techniques.
  • Track record with silicon reliability on process nodes and advanced packaging technologies.

title: Senior Analyst, Government Affairs and Public Policy, YouTube
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Analyst within the Government Affairs and Public Policy team at YouTube in Singapore, you will play a crucial role in supporting YouTube's policy efforts within the Asia Pacific region. You will contribute to shaping YouTube's regulatory policy strategy by coordinating with various internal teams, including Trust and Safety, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, PR, Marketing, and Product teams, as well as Google’s global Government Affairs and Public Policy team. Your role involves monitoring, analyzing, and helping to distill YouTube's perspective on important public policy challenges. You will assist in developing and implementing public policy strategies and contribute to policy positions for review by YouTube's policy and leadership teams. Your expertise will be used to support external engagement efforts and to ensure relevant and timely internal communications regarding policy developments. You will engage externally and internally on behalf of YouTube. You will need strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills to manage multiple projects and respond to policy challenges effectively. You will be part of a closely coordinated Asia Pacific team, which is part of the global YouTube Government Affairs and Public Policy team, impacting initiatives vital to YouTube's mission.

Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyze legislative and regulatory developments across the region, providing insightful analysis and actionable recommendations to inform YouTube’s overall policy strategy and regional operational planning work.
  • Support the development and execution of core team priorities for APAC YouTube GAPP, working alongside experienced policy colleagues on executive engagement strategies and global stakeholder engagement initiatives.
  • Assist in developing presentations and materials to support cross-functional annual planning and deliver executive updates on ongoing regional and global public policy strategies across the APAC region.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners within and beyond GAPP, such as Communications and Marketing, to write, develop, and publish high-quality policy-related collateral and educational stakeholder resources and materials.
  • Advise product teams on policy implications during launches, while actively building and nurturing trusted relationships with policymakers, trade associations, industry partners, academics, and key non-profit group allies.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in policy analysis and campaigns, working on technology issues or the policy environments that surround them.
  • 4 years of experience working within government, think tanks, public interest groups, technology industry groups, or corporate public policy organizations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 7 years of experience working on relevant policy issues within government, think tanks, public interest groups, or corporate public policy organizations.
  • Experience with internet technologies and the policy environments that surround them.
  • Knowledge of current and emerging public policy trends relating to online content platforms and technology generally.
  • Understanding of YouTube’s primary product offerings and their intersection with the public policy environment, with demonstrated experience advising and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver exceptional work product.
  • Strong communicator, writer, and project manager, with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment and exercise good judgment.

title: Radiological Expert, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
Google invites applications from highly qualified physicists and nuclear engineers for the position of Radiological Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the CBRNE team within the Responsible Development and Innovation (ReDI) team.

The successful applicant will be hired for a Research Scientist position serving as a technical expert evaluating and mitigating safety risks of frontier AI models (primarily but not limited to LLMs) in the radiological domain; specifically, model assistance in radiation and neutron transport modeling, radiation detector defeat and shielding optimization, reactor operations and monitoring, and radiological source managing in a demonstrably unclassified and non-export controlled manner.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Construct threat models prioritizing vulnerabilities, threat actors, and scenarios related to fission, fusion, thermonuclear weapons development, and high-energy-density dual-use regimes.
  • Create evaluation datasets of complex physics and nuclear engineering prompts to elicit the maximum capability of the model to determine how to uplift malicious actors (e.g., revealing tacit knowledge, novel procedures, time/cost reduction, detectability reduction) across the domain.
  • Collaborate with engineers to design mitigations that block harmful outputs without overly degrading the model's scientific utility. Similar to writing capability evaluations, this requires a deep understanding of dual-use science.
  • Support development and refinement of Google’s nuclear safety policy. Communicate complex risks, evaluation findings, and mitigation strategies to leadership and technical/non-technical external stakeholders.
  • Develop mathematical and computational frameworks to quantify capability thresholds, technical feasibility, and potential consequences of model uplift wherever possible.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD and Postdoctoral research experience in Particle Physics, Plasma Physics, Nuclear Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3 years of experience in research with US national laboratories or security initiatives (e.g., IAEA, NNSA, DARPA, or academic consortia).
  • Experience in research or policy in radiological/nuclear security, safeguards, nonproliferation, material control, or threat reduction.
  • Experience in radiation/neutron transport, reactor monitoring, detection, dosimetry, shielding defeat, and RDD/RED mechanics.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience applying ML to radiation detection, detector calibration, or nuclear/particle event reconstruction.
  • Experience in AI safety, evaluations, red-teaming, or applied AI research in lab, academic, or industry settings.
  • Experience in data analysis, scientific computing (e.g., Python or C++), and simulation in neutron/radiation transport, detector response, or plume dispersion.
  • Experience using AI models/agents to enhance capabilities and lower technical barriers.
  • Ability to design evaluations and mitigations that are demonstrably unclassified and non-export controlled by developing dual use science proxies for weapons topics. Highly collaborative, comfortable with peer review, and committed to respectful teamwork.

descriptionHtml:
