Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Completed relevant industry course/certification offerings such as CEH, GIAC or CompTIA Sec+.
  • 5 years of experience in SOC-related roles, responding to and addressing security incidents.
  • Experience in technical troubleshooting and writing code in one or more programming languages.
  • Active, or the ability to obtain, a Developed Vetting (DV) UK security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Security+ or similar Cyber Security/Incident Response related certifications.
  • Experience responding to security incidents on Kubernetes.
  • Experience analyzing, triaging, and remediating common information security incidents.
  • Understanding of common attacker tactics, tools, and techniques.
  • Excellent problem-solving and investigative skills.
  • Active UK Developed Vetting (DV) Security Clearance.

title: Software Engineer III, Search
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The AIGC Platform is the foundational infrastructure responsible for the entire lifecycle of AI-generated content (AI Overviews and AI Cards), including LLM-based topic ingestion, content clustering, summary generation, quality evaluation, and publishing. Our platform enables product teams to rapidly develop and experiment with new AI-first formats, transforming the Discover feed into a dynamic, AI-powered knowledge and entertainment companion. We ensure that AI-generated content is fresh, factual, grounded, and safely delivered to millions of users globally by integrating rigorous automated quality gates and efficient LLM agentic workflows. By centralizing AIGC creation, we enable optimizing heavy compute resources and streamlining the pipeline from real-world events to personalized user feeds and notifications.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain robust and scalable backend infrastructure, data pipelines, and software solutions for the AIGC Platform.
  • Build scalable, low-latency, and high-throughput streaming and batch data pipelines to handle massive content ingestion, clustering, deduplication, and publishing to serving indexes.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Product Managers, UX, Data Scientists, Quality teams and downstream Ranking/Retrieval teams, to drive technical designs and unblock new AI content use cases.
  • Analyze and optimize system performance, pipeline latency, monitor service health, and manage compute capacity to ensure operational excellence.
  • Make independent technical contributions and deliver on end-to-end tasks within the platform's broader transformation goals.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., C++ or Python).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Experience building, maintaining, and scaling high-performance, data-intensive distributed backend systems and data processing pipelines.
  • Experience with frameworks and tools relevant to AI/ML development, LLM inference, agent-based architectures, and generative AI deployment.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, content recommendation systems, search technologies, or information retrieval.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a track record of thriving in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, and excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple specialized engineering and product teams.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the implementation of physical design methodologies.
  • Take ownership of one or more physical design partitions or top level.
  • Manage timing and power consumption of the design.
  • Contribute to design methodology, libraries, and code review.
  • Define the physical design related rule sets for the functional design engineers.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with advanced design, including clock/voltage domain crossing, design for testing (DFT), and low power designs.
  • Experience with system on a chip (SoC) cycles.
  • Experience in high-performance, high-frequency, and low-power designs.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience in coding with System Verilog and scripting with TCL.
  • Experience with layout verification and design rules.
  • Experience with very large scale integration (VLSI) design in SoC or multiple-cycles of SoC in ASIC design.

title: Director, Security Defense Platforms
descriptionHtml:
As the Director of Security Defense Platforms, you will lead the global software engineering organization responsible for the foundational software, streaming pipelines, telemetry architectures, and AI-driven automated containment infrastructure that powers all of Alphabet’s detection and response operations.

In this role, you will be an executive engineering leader with experience building massive-scale distributed data systems, driving high-reliability platform engineering, and advocating advanced security automation and agentic defense. You will bridge software engineering with cyber defense partnering closely with Detection and Response domain leads, and enterprise platform teams to transform Google’s security posture from reactive "Detect and Respond" to proactive "Infer and Interrupt".

Additionally, you will manage, grow, and mentor a globally distributed organization of Software Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers across multiple global sites. You will own the long-term architectural road map for the Detection and Response teams core infrastructure. You will lead the engineering and deployment of automated threat containment (e.g., automated mitigation pipelines, and dynamic endpoint mitigation) to disrupt high-risk access abuse, workspace DLP, and intrusion attempts in real-time. You will drive the integration of AI models and agentic reasoning into operational workflows, automating alert triage, incident summaries, and investigative workflows. You will ensure platform reliability, multi-region resilience, and SLO compliance, reducing operational toil and on-call burden to established target of engineering bandwidth.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Foster a high-performance engineering culture emphasizing technical aptitude, operational excellence, and continuous architectural innovation.
  • Deliver large-scale resource optimization initiatives, drastically reducing global data storage and compute footprints while maintaining strict end-to-end detection latencies.
  • Institutionalize configuration-based detection frameworks that cut authoring and productionization cycles down to industry-leading velocity.
  • Advocate for novel defense mechanisms for autonomous third-party agent security, data leakage mitigation, and federated access auditing.
  • Deliver against executive and board-level cyber security risk reduction commitments.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cyber security, or equivalent practical experience
  • 15 years of software engineering and technical leadership experience, including 6 years of experience managing managers and leading multi-site engineering organizations
  • Experience partnering with security operations, threat intelligence, or incident response teams to build developer and detection platforms
  • Experience using modern AI/ML applications in cyber security including automated reasoning, LLM-based agent evaluation, anomaly detection, and synthetic threat injection/watermarking

Preferred qualifications:

  • 20 years of experience in software engineering, distributed systems, or enterprise platform infrastructure, with experience in cyber security or threat defense domains
  • Experience architecting Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), SIEM, EDR data fabrics, or real-time event correlation engines
  • Experience designing, building, and operating distributed streaming pipelines, query engines, and high-throughput data processing systems operating at enterprise/hyper-scale
  • Experience with cross-functional leadership and executive presence to translate deep architectural challenges into clear business and security risk decisions for VP/SVP stakeholders
  • Expertise in infrastructure cost optimization, data lifecycle/retention governance, and high-availability streaming SLO management

title: Data Center Technician Intern, 2027
descriptionHtml:
Behind Google’s simple search box is one of the most complex technology infrastructures in the world and behind that infrastructure is a various group of Googlers, who design, build, and keep the lights on for our users. Our Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future, and our technicians, engineers, and support teams bring ideas to life. The teams use creative approaches to reduce operational costs and to extend traditional practices to meet our goal of making our data centers the most energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable in the world.

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you'll be a key part of the Data Center team, gaining experience by helping with the installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of hardware, including servers and their components, as well as server software like Google's Linux cluster. You'll learn how to configure and manage network components such as routers, hubs, bridges, and switches. Additionally, you will be involved in manual movement and rack installation of equipment and may even have the opportunity to participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations. This internship is a fantastic opportunity to build a solid foundation in data center operations and network infrastructure.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Responsibilities and detailed projects will be determined based on your educational background, interest, and skills.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in an educational program relevant to the job qualifications or an accredited full-time Bachelor's or Master's degree program located in the EMEA region.
  • Relevant practical or internship experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Relevant practical to internship experience performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g. Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc).
  • Relevant practical to internship experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
  • Ability to complete a 13 week full-time internship in the internship location starting either May, June or July 2027.
  • Currently enrolled in your penultimate/final year of education.

title: Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customer environments. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as a "builder-consultant," moving beyond architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions.

This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will solve the integration complexities, data readiness, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment and acting as a critical feedback loop for Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the "Discovery-to-Deployment" journey, serving as the lead developer for AI applications and transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems and MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
  • Bridge the enterprise gap by architecting and coding the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.
  • Engineer for production excellence, building high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet the requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Act as a product catalyst, identifying repeatable field patterns and technical "friction points" in Google’s AI stack and converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Drive regional leadership and upskilling by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience shipping production-grade AI-driven solutions to external or internal customers.
  • Experience building full-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
  • Experience in Python.
  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
  • Experience leading technical discovery sessions with executive stakeholders (C-suite) and engineering teams to define AI and hardware infrastructure requirements.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s ADK) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.
  • Knowledge of "Large Language Model-native" metrics (tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
  • Ability to implement secure agentic workflows incorporating Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool-calling, and OAuth-based authentication.

title: Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, Google Cloud Platforms, Infrastructure Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Google's custom-designed machines make up one of the largest and most powerful computing infrastructures in the world. The Hardware Testing Engineering team ensures that this cutting-edge equipment is reliable. In the R&D lab, you design test equipment for prototypes of our machinery and develop the protocols used to scale these tests for the entire global team. Working closely with design engineers, you give input on designs to improve our hardware until you're sure it meets Google's standards of quality and reliability.

As a Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, you will evaluate the product designs and create the manufacturing test processes, tools and procedures behind the products powering Google’s Data Centers, Google Cloud and Google’s Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning. When vendors build parts for our infrastructure, you are right there alongside ensuring manufacturing test processes are repeatable and controlled. You will collaborate with Commodity Managers and Design Engineers to determine Google’s infrastructure needs and product specifications. Your work will ensure the various pieces of Google’s infrastructure fit together perfectly and keep our systems humming along smoothly for a seamless user experience.

You will be expected to travel internationally up to 20% of the time as needed.

Our Platforms Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds the
hardware and software technologies that power all of Google's services. Our computational challenges are complex and unique, enabled by cutting-edge custom hardware designed and made in-house. As a hardware engineer, you will design and build the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. You will see those systems from concept all the way through to high-volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our cutting-edge data centers, affecting millions of Google users.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $144000 - $208000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive manufacturing test development for new and existing product designs. Architect and write test software to drive end-to-end test coverage based on product and quality requirements.
  • Develop automated test scripts for functional and system tests, software installation using Python.
  • Design, build, and deploy test platforms for Google's global manufacturing partners.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and root cause manufacturing yield issues and field escapes. Drive issues to closure with preventive measures.
  • Define the manufacturing test strategy for new products and work with our partners to jointly develop the required test solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience as a Manufacturing Test, Quality, Reliability, or Product Engineer.
  • 8 years of experience developing manufacturing test solutions for PCBAs and computer systems.
  • 6 years of experience developing or integrating manufacturing test hardware using custom electronics, fixtures and instrumentation and using Python for automation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10 years of experience in manufacturing tests and software development using Python.
  • Experience with creating end-to-end manufacturing test strategies from structural through functional and system tests.
  • Experience with architecting complex manufacturing test solutions for high-performance compute-based products (i.e., GPUs).

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người kiến tạo sự tăng trưởng chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, mang lại giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động nhằm thúc đẩy sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác. Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ vận dụng tư duy nhạy bén trong kinh doanh để xác định, định hướng và thu hút khách hàng bằng các giải pháp Hiệu suất dựa trên AI của Google (Tìm kiếm). Bạn sẽ cung cấp dịch vụ khách hàng, nghiên cứu và phân tích thị trường theo chuẩn của Google, đồng thời dự đoán cách đưa ra quyết định, thấu hiểu những điểm khác biệt tinh vi của từng chiến dịch, cũng như không ngừng tìm tòi và khám phá nhu cầu của các lĩnh vực kinh doanh chủ chốt. Cùng với khách hàng, bạn sẽ đặt ra mục tiêu và chiến lược để quảng cáo của họ có thể tiếp cận người dùng một cách hiệu quả nhất.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Duy trì mối quan hệ bền chặt với khách hàng, công ty quảng cáo và các bên liên quan trọng yếu khác để đảm bảo phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh và thúc đẩy hợp tác thành công.
  • Thiết kế và giới thiệu các giải pháp mang tính đột phá, dựa trên dữ liệu (Tìm kiếm dựa trên AI) phù hợp với nhu cầu của khách hàng. Tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và kỹ năng kể chuyện lôi cuốn để xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều, thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh thu.
  • Chỉ đạo thực thi các sáng kiến chiến lược để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng và tăng doanh thu cho các giải pháp hiệu suất dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), từ đó đổi mới hoạt động quảng cáo của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích và tối ưu hoá Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI) tiếp thị bằng cách theo dõi và đánh giá hiệu suất của các chiến dịch dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), đưa ra các đề xuất dựa trên dữ liệu để không ngừng cải thiện.
  • Nắm bắt các xu hướng và cải tiến trong ngành tiếp thị kỹ thuật số, cung cấp thông tin chi tiết và đề xuất chủ động để đảm bảo đội ngũ và khách hàng luôn dẫn đầu trong bối cảnh không ngừng thay đổi.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc có kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo, tư vấn bán hàng hoặc phát triển kinh doanh.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng cả tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh để làm việc với các bên liên quan trong nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm thúc đẩy thay đổi và phối hợp với nhiều bên liên quan.
  • Có kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án liên chức năng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm trong ngành trò chơi.
  • Có kinh nghiệm thiết lập mối quan hệ và bán hàng cho các bên liên quan ở cấp điều hành.
  • Am hiểu về các hoạt động và mô hình kinh doanh truyền thông liên chức năng.
  • Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.

title: Technical Program Manager III, Infrastructure Capacity Planning, Global Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.

Integrated Capacity Group is the single orderer of compute and storage quota and the operator of shared and dedicated Flex resource pools across Technical Infrastructure, Core, Search, Platforms and Devices, Geo.We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end capacity planning, forecasting, and supply fulfillment for dedicated resources.

Unlike large shared pools where workloads statistically multiplex across tens of thousands of machines, dedicated security-isolated pools require tight cluster-level hardware planning across failure domains, machine platforms, data center power constraints, and cross-product area quota conversions.

In this role, you will build the forecasting and supply engine for these dedicated pools and specialty dedicated infrastructure. You will replace ad-hoc spreadsheets with automated demand models, translate multi-quarter service migrations into physical machine orders and shared-to-dedicated quota exchanges, validate power feasibility, and drive annual planning and budget escalations.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Own the capacity forecast for dedicated machine pools across all global clusters, modeling organic growth, new cluster turnups, and large inorganic service migrations.
  • Translate logical resource demands into physical dedicated machine supply, ensuring every cell meets hardware platform rules and failure-domain minimums across switches and mzones.
  • Drive two supply fulfillment paths for dedicated pools, placing long-lead orders with power validation, and executing faster shared-to-dedicated machine conversions by transferring donor quota and coordinating drains.
  • Lead annual planning, allocation reconciliation, and the escalation cycle for specialty dedicated infrastructure orders.
  • Partner with Compute Security Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), Cluster Management TI Resource Managers (TIRMs), and migrating product area Product Area Resource Manager (PARMs) across Cloud, Core, Search, and Technical Infrastructure (TI) to unblock and onboard services without stocking out constrained clusters.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience with data analysis, business intelligence, or dashboarding tools (e.g., SQL or metrics platforms).
  • Experience with infrastructure capacity planning.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • 5 years of experience in technical program management, capacity planning, product area resource management, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Experience writing SQL queries and building data models or dashboards to analyze fleet utilization, demand forecasts, or supply-chain bottlenecks.
  • Experience translating software workload requirements such as compute, memory, local storage, and failure-domain redundancy into physical infrastructure capacity plans.

title: Regional Enablement Lead (English, Japanese)
descriptionHtml:
The Japan Regional Enablement Lead (REL) acts as a partner to the Japan Office of the President, COO and Chief of Staff. You will be the critical link between global enablement strategy and regional execution, responsible for supporting the priorities across Japan.

In this role, you will balance the need for global consistency with the necessity of local relevance, ensuring that Cloud Googlers in Japan are equipped to lead with AI and execute our GTM priorities, accelerating performance through engaging and relevant enablement that contributes to impactful business outcomes and fosters a culture of excellence.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and execute the enablement plan. Act as a member of the Japan extended leadership team, providing a bidirectional feedback loop.
  • Drive daily usage and proficiency in tools like Gemini Enterprise and NotebookLM. Enable field sales representatives and customer engineers to move beyond technical features to deliver AI-first business narratives.
  • Lead Gemini Enterprise initiatives, tailoring global business assets into sessions that resonate with the Japan market and manager community of practice, focusing on coaching through uncertainty.
  • Deploy refresher resources that empower managers to help their teams create value narratives. Execute required learning through internal learning management systems.
  • Ensure that the region attains 80% or more completion of required courses. Translate and adapt global business plays into local market contexts to ensure relevance.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in management consulting, sales enablement, program management, or sales operations.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Japanese fluently for global collaboration with stakeholder engagement.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience taking broad global concepts and developing structured, localized plans for a regional field.
  • Experience guiding sales teams through organizational restructuring or role transformations.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud products or similar cloud technology platforms.
  • Ability to partner with the Japan leadership team to prioritize enablement interventions.

title: Senior GPU Performance Software Engineer, AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. descriptionHtml:

The Google Cloud Logistics (GCL) Capacity Planning team ensures the operational readiness and scalability of Google's global logistics network. In this role, you will own end-to-end capacity planning, transforming demand forecasts into executable operational plans. You will bridge supply chain strategy and on-the-ground execution by designing and owning the quantitative models that govern network flow, storage, throughput, and labor. You will use SQL, data pipelines, and analytical models to simulate sourcing changes, stress-test network capacity (e.g., space, dock throughput, labor), and run scenarios to balance workloads. You will establish and lead planning cycles, including regional Demand-Supply Reviews (DSR) with Operations and third-party logistics (3PL) partners, integrating commitments into monthly S&OP/D&OP processes. You will also partner with Engineering and Product teams as a subject matter expert to codify business logic and network constraints into automated, scalable planning tools.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Establish and govern repeatable capacity planning processes, planning calendars, and forecast lock cycles from the ground up, embedding warehouse and data center capacity plans into monthly S&OP/D&OP cycles, rolling commits, and quarterly/annual budgeting.
  • Own key forecast health metrics, including plan-vs-actual variance and forecast accuracy/bias (WAPE, MAPE), driving root-cause analysis and continuous calibration of the underlying models and parameters that enable constraint planning.
  • Design, build, and own forecasting and capacity models that enable constraint planning across GCL global warehouses and data centers, translating upstream supply chain and deployment schedules into multi-horizon plans across storage space, dock throughput, and labor.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Expertise in physical logistics capacity and distribution planning, modeling network flows, sourcing rule changes, storage footprint, dock throughput, and labor capacity across short and long-term horizons.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or statistical modeling tools to build capacity pipelines, simulate network/sourcing changes, analyze plan-vs-actual variances, and improve forecast accuracy (WAPE, MAPE, Bias).

title: Software Engineer III, Search, AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain robust, well-tested software across the entire development lifecycle to mitigate a full range of external and internal access-related security risks within Search.
  • Contribute to the codebase by authoring technical design documents, participating in code reviews, and driving debugging and testing efforts to ensure high system reliability.
  • Translate the team's high-level goals into actionable tasks, and align your daily work with quarterly objective and key results (OKRs) to deliver on project milestones alongside peer engineers, T/PgMs, and other stakeholders.
  • Foster a collaborative, and safe environment by communicating effectively and supporting your peers, while bringing the AI fluency expected to your daily engineering workflows.
  • Be prepared to discuss the knowledge and use of AI tools during the hiring process with fluency in AI.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in C++.
  • Experience in designing, building, or operating large-scale distributed systems.
  • Experience in software architecture, system design, and full-cycle software implementations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in data privacy, data protection, or secure data handling practices.
  • Experience in policy compliance, regulatory frameworks, or governance.'
  • Experience in database querying, data extraction, and analysis using SQL.
  • Experience in log analysis, system monitoring, and technical troubleshooting in large-scale or distributed environments.

title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Applications
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Performance, Rewards, and Global Mobility (PRGM) team, you will guide the product strategy and execution of agentic applications across total rewards, benefits, and performance management. Operating as "Customer Zero" with Google's latest Gemini models, you will partner cross-functionally to replace legacy, form-based workflows with intelligent, multi-agent experiences. These products will empower Googlers and leaders to make critical talent and compensation decisions with speed and transparency.

Bridging product goal with technical execution, you will define multi-agent orchestration patterns and hybrid reasoning pipelines. By establishing thorough evaluation frameworks for accuracy and privacy, you will establish best practices for how enterprise-grade AI agents operate at Google scale.

At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the multi-year product goal, strategy, and roadmap for agentic applications across the Performance, Rewards, and Global Mobility (PRGM) portfolio.
  • Lead the end-to-end design and launch of Agentic Application Services (A2S) that combine conversational and proactive AI agents with enterprise workflows for compensation, total rewards, benefits navigation, and performance management.
  • Partner with Engineering and AI Architects to build on the agentic platform, leveraging Agent-to-Model and A2A orchestration, MCP tool ecosystems, and governed Data grounding.
  • Establish AI evaluation and quality standards, including golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge autoraters, human-in-the-loop domain calibration, latency SLAs, and privacy and compliance guardrails
  • Provide functional product leadership to cross-functional pods of Engineers, Business Systems Analysts, and UX designers to translate global policy and business rules into scalable platform capabilities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows, including grounding/RAG architectures, tool use, or AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience with cross-functional product strategy across enterprise systems and data platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • Experience architecting and shipping multi-agent systems, MCP (model context protocol) integrations, A2A (agent-to-agent) orchestration, and hybrid workflows that blend deterministic business logic with LLM reasoning.
  • Domain experience in enterprise HR Tech, FinTech, or high-stakes enterprise decision-support platforms.
  • Experience partnering with BSAs (business system analysts), data engineering teams, and policy owners to unify fragmented data sources into clean, governed semantic layers
  • Experience transforming legacy enterprise applications into modern, AI-native experiences.
  • Executive communication and investigative skills, with experience framing ambiguous organizational problems into outcome metrics and structured product tradeoffs.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Detection and Response Consultant, Cyber Defence, National Security, Mandiant

title: Data Center Facilities Engineer, Controls (English)
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as servers, network equipment, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), system administration, access control, alarm investigation, and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) management.
  • Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/ladder logic/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
  • Manage control, monitoring, logging, and alarming systems.
  • Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
  • Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new controls equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in developing, operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting control systems of industrial facilities (e.g., automation PLCs).
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.
  • Ability to communicate in English fluently to interact with stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Industry standard certifications related to system administration (e.g., CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Certified Windows or Linux system administrator).
  • Experience in controls/automation, or construction/technical environment or a related field.
  • Experience in data centers, hospitals, power plants, or laboratories.
  • Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, knowledge of cyber security, and proficiency in operating systems.
  • Ability to communicate in Japanese fluently to work with local vendors.
